column1: # AsyncAPI 2.x and 3.x counters, YAML or JSON, for a rule with the prompt file-body-contract: one
# per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks YAML comments (a whole line, or
# from a # after a blank) and the body of a block scalar (the lines below a | or >, as deep as its
# first line, which sets the block's indentation as YAML reads it; its key stays), so a description
# that quotes a channel or a "type: object" does not count. A key counts with or without JSON
# quotes. "channel addresses" counts the address of a 3.x (a value on its line, so a schema property
# named address, which opens a mapping, does not count) channel; "operations" a 2.x publish or
# subscribe that opens a mapping and a 3.x action send or receive; "payloads" the payload of every
# message. OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every
